about.metaDescription: Learn about Javier Maldonado, a GTA real estate professional offering personalized guidance for buyers, sellers, renters, and investors.
about.title: Personal Guidance for Every GTA Move
about.subtitle: Javier Maldonado provides clear, bilingual real estate support across Etobicoke, Mississauga, Milton, Brampton, and Oakville.
about.storySubtitle: Real estate decisions are personal. Javier focuses on listening first, then building a plan that fits your goals, timeline, and comfort level.
about.storyBody: Whether you are purchasing your first home, preparing to sell, searching for a rental, or evaluating an investment property, you receive straightforward guidance without pressure. Javier works with Avila Realty Group Inc., Brokerage and serves clients throughout the Greater Toronto Area in English and Spanish.
values: Clear communication at every stage of the process
Local market insight across core GTA communities
Bilingual support in English and Spanish
Honest guidance tailored to your priorities

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your information.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you submit a form, book a consultation, or contact us, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, property details, and any information you choose to provide in your message.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
sections.body: We use your information to respond to inquiries, schedule consultations, provide real estate services, and improve our communications. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For privacy-related questions, contact Javier Maldonado at jamaldonado@live.ca or call +1 (647) 638-4303.
